title: Quantum-Classical Separation in Probability Distribution Transport via Nonlocal Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.21840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In many-body physics and generative artificial intelligence, locality provides a natural notion of phase equivalence: two quantum states or classical probability distributions are regarded as in the same phase when local dynamics can reversibly transform one into the other. This raises a fundamental question: can local quantum dynamics transport classical probability distributions in ways that local classical dynamics cannot? We establish a quantum-classical separation in distribution transport: two classical distributions can be connected exactly and reversibly by a constant-depth local quantum circuit, whereas classical stochastic transport requires a substantially larger spatial range. We demonstrate this separation explicitly on a one-dimensional chain and develop a general construction principle on graphs, based on nonlocal games. translated_abstract: 在多体物理和生成式人工智能中，局域性为“相”的等价性提供了一个自然的定义：当局域动力学能够可逆地将一个量子态或经典概率分布变换为另一个时，两者被视为处于同一相。由此引出一个根本性问题：局域量子动力学能否以局域经典动力学无法实现的方式输运经典概率分布？我们在分布输运中建立了一个量子-经典分离：两个经典分布可以被常数深度的局域量子电路精确且可逆地连接起来，而经典随机输运要实现同样的连接则需要大得多的空间范围。我们在一维链上明确演示了这种分离，并基于非局域博弈发展出一种适用于图结构的一般性构造原理。此外，源分布本身可以由一个简单的局域经典过程生成。
tldr: 该论文建立了一个量子-经典分离：常数深度的局域量子电路能够精确且可逆地连接两个经典概率分布，而经典随机输运实现同样的连接需要大得多的空间范围，并借助非局域博弈给出了图上的一般性构造原理。
